cards.example: 元朝是少数民族统治全国的政权。
cards.exampleTranslation: The Yuan Dynasty was a regime where an ethnic minority ruled the whole country.
cards.breakdown: 统：丝线（纟）把所有东西统统串在一起 · 治：用水（氵）把台地上的洪水治理好

cards.example: 元朝把人分为四个等级的政策很不得人心。
cards.exampleTranslation: The Yuan policy of dividing people into four ranks was very unpopular.
cards.breakdown: 政：用行动（攵）维持正确（正）的秩序 · 策：竹简（竹）上写下的计谋，用来推动执行

cards.example: 蒙古族是少数民族。
cards.exampleTranslation: The Mongols are an ethnic minority.
cards.breakdown: 少：数目很少，只有几个点 · 族：旗帜（方）下聚集的一群人（矢）

cards.back: provincial system (Yuan's way of governing regions)
cards.example: 元朝建立了行省制度管理辽阔的国家。
cards.exampleTranslation: The Yuan established the provincial system to govern the vast country.
cards.breakdown: 行：两条腿走路，表示行动和管理 · 省：用眼睛（目）少看一点，节省又精简

cards.example: 元朝把国人分为四个等级。
cards.exampleTranslation: The Yuan divided people into four social classes.
cards.breakdown: 等：竹简（竹）上写着寺庙（寺）的规矩，大家排队等候 · 级：丝线（纟）一级一级往上爬

cards.example: 汉人和南人受到歧视。
cards.exampleTranslation: Han and Southern people faced discrimination.
cards.breakdown: 歧：走路时脚分叉，走了不同的路 · 视：像眼睛在看，带着偏见判断别人

cards.example: 红巾军起义推翻了元朝。
cards.exampleTranslation: The Red Turban uprising overthrew the Yuan Dynasty.
cards.breakdown: 起：自己（己）走起来（走），出发行动 · 义：心里有善良（羊），愿意牺牲自己

cards.back: territory / the land a country controls
cards.example: 元朝的疆域比以往任何朝代都要辽阔。
cards.exampleTranslation: The Yuan territory was more vast than any previous dynasty.
cards.breakdown: 疆：弓（弓）箭划出边界（土），表示国家的领土范围 · 域：用武器（戈）守护自己的土地（土）

cards.example: 元朝管理着辽阔的国家。
cards.exampleTranslation: The Yuan governed a vast country.
cards.breakdown: 辽：走很远的路（辶）才能到达 · 阔：水（氵）很宽广，连门（门）都装不下

cards.example: 西藏成为元朝的正式行政区。
cards.exampleTranslation: Tibet became an official administrative region of the Yuan.
cards.breakdown: 藏：草丛（艹）中藏着宝贝，藏起来不见了

cards.example: 元朝设立澎湖巡检司管理澎湖列岛。
cards.exampleTranslation: The Yuan set up the Penghu Patrol Office to govern the Penghu Islands.

cards.example: 元朝管理澎湖列岛和琉球（今台湾）。
cards.exampleTranslation: The Yuan governed the Penghu Islands and Ryukyu (today's Taiwan).
cards.breakdown: 琉：像流水一样的玉石（王旁） · 球：玉（王旁）做成的圆球

cards.back: patrol inspector / official who checks on a region
cards.example: 元朝设立澎湖巡检司。
cards.exampleTranslation: The Yuan established the Penghu Patrol Inspection Office.
cards.breakdown: 巡：走来走去（辶）绕一圈，检查情况 · 检：用木头（木）做标签，一一查验（佥）

cards.example: 元朝官员清查户口和收税。
cards.exampleTranslation: Yuan officials checked household registers and collected taxes.
cards.breakdown: 户：半扇门，代表一家人住的地方 · 口：张开的嘴，代表家里的人口

cards.example: 官员负责收税。
cards.exampleTranslation: Officials were responsible for collecting taxes.
cards.breakdown: 收：用手（攵）把散落的东西收拢起来 · 税：把粮食（禾）换成（兑）钱交给国家

cards.example: 中国有五十六个民族。
cards.exampleTranslation: China has fifty-six ethnic groups.
cards.breakdown: 民：古代表示被统治的人民 · 族：旗帜（方）下聚集的一群人（矢）

cards.example: 欧亚之间的商业活动相当活跃。
cards.exampleTranslation: Commercial activities between Europe and Asia were quite vibrant.
cards.breakdown: 活：像水（氵）一样流动，充满生命力 · 跃：脚（足）使劲跳起来，生气勃勃

cards.back: unobstructed passage / travel freely without barriers
cards.example: 东西方来往的道路通行无阻。
cards.exampleTranslation: The routes between East and West had unobstructed passage.
cards.breakdown: 通：走通了（辶）整条路 · 阻：土山挡在路上，无阻就是没有阻碍

cards.example: 元朝中期，海外贸易空前发达。
cards.exampleTranslation: In the mid-Yuan period, overseas trade was unprecedentedly thriving.
cards.breakdown: 发：头发生长，引申为出发、蓬勃发展 · 达：走路（辶）到达（大）目的地，成功了

cards.back: to bring land under cultivation / clear land for farming
cards.example: 忽必烈让百姓开垦田地，种桑养蚕。
cards.exampleTranslation: Kublai Khan had the people cultivate the land and grow mulberry to raise silkworms.
cards.breakdown: 开：用手把门打开，引申为开辟 · 垦：用力翻开土地（土），让荒地变良田

cards.example: 忽必烈下令保护农业。
cards.exampleTranslation: Kublai Khan ordered the protection of agriculture.
cards.breakdown: 农：在田野里弯腰劳作的人，辛苦耕作 · 业：像书架一排排竖立，表示一项事业

cards.example: 蒙古人在治理国家上经验不足。
cards.exampleTranslation: The Mongols lacked experience in governing a country.
cards.breakdown: 经：丝线（纟）从头到尾穿过，走过每一个环节 · 验：经过考验（佥），证明了自己的能力

cards.back: to advocate / to promote (an idea or practice)
cards.example: 忽必烈提倡以儒学为主的汉族传统文化。
cards.exampleTranslation: Kublai Khan advocated Han traditional culture centered on Confucianism.
cards.breakdown: 提：用手（扌）把东西提出来，让大家注意 · 倡：人（亻）站出来带头鼓励大家跟随

cards.example: 忽必烈使元朝面貌一新。
cards.exampleTranslation: Kublai Khan gave the Yuan Dynasty a completely new look.
cards.breakdown: 面：脸的轮廓，四方形里有眼睛 · 貌：看起来的样子，外表和形象

cards.example: 忽必烈是一位杰出的皇帝。
cards.exampleTranslation: Kublai Khan was an outstanding emperor.
cards.breakdown: 杰：树木（木）上有鸟（大），站得比别人高 · 出：从山洞里走出来，超越了原来的界限

cards.back: Yuan opera / a type of verse and drama popular in the Yuan Dynasty
cards.example: 元代文化最著名的是元曲，它是中国现代戏曲的开端。
cards.exampleTranslation: The most famous Yuan culture is Yuan opera, which is the beginning of modern Chinese drama.
cards.breakdown: 曲：弯弯曲曲的形状，像歌曲的旋律起伏不定

cards.back: spinning wheel (machine for making thread and cloth)
cards.example: 黄道婆改进纺车技术，使棉布大量生产。
cards.exampleTranslation: Huang Daopo improved spinning wheel technology, enabling mass production of cotton cloth.
cards.breakdown: 纺：用丝线（纟）按照一定方向（方）纺织 · 车：有轮子转动的机器

cards.example: 忽必烈提倡以儒学为主的汉族传统文化。
cards.exampleTranslation: Kublai Khan promoted Han traditional culture centered on Confucianism.
cards.breakdown: 儒：人（亻）需要（需）学习，指读书人和学者 · 学：双手教孩子在屋子（宀）里学习

cards.back: Dou E Yuan – a famous Yuan opera about an innocent woman wrongly executed
cards.example: 《窦娥冤》是元曲的代表作品。
cards.exampleTranslation: Dou E Yuan is a masterpiece of Yuan opera.
cards.breakdown: 冤：兔子（兔）被关在网（冂）里，受了委屈，大声喊冤！

cards.back: Yuan Dynasty (1271–1368) – China's first minority-ruled dynasty
cards.example: 元朝是中国历史上第一个少数民族统治全国的政权。
cards.exampleTranslation: The Yuan Dynasty was the first minority-ruled regime to govern all of China.

cards.back: Kublai Khan – Mongol ruler who founded the Yuan Dynasty in 1271
cards.example: 1271年，忽必烈建立元朝，迁都大都（北京）。
cards.exampleTranslation: In 1271, Kublai Khan founded the Yuan Dynasty and moved the capital to Dadu (Beijing).

cards.example: 元朝是蒙古族建立的王朝。
cards.exampleTranslation: The Yuan Dynasty was a dynasty founded by the Mongol ethnic group.
cards.breakdown: 族：旗帜（方）下聚集的一群人（矢）

cards.back: Marco Polo – Italian traveler who wrote about China and amazed Europe
cards.example: 马可·波罗写的《马可·波罗游记》轰动了欧洲。
cards.exampleTranslation: Marco Polo's travel memoir caused a sensation in Europe.

cards.back: Guo Shoujing – Yuan astronomer who created the Shoushi Calendar
cards.example: 郭守敬编成的《授时历》与现行的公历相同。
cards.exampleTranslation: Guo Shoujing's Shoushi Calendar matches today's Gregorian calendar.

cards.back: Huang Daopo – Yuan inventor who improved cotton spinning technology
cards.example: 黄道婆改进纺车技术，使棉布在中国大量生产。
cards.exampleTranslation: Huang Daopo improved spinning technology, enabling mass production of cotton cloth in China.

cards.back: Zhu Yuanzhang – rebel leader who defeated the Yuan and founded the Ming Dynasty
cards.example: 义军领袖朱元璋带兵打败元军，元朝灭亡。
cards.exampleTranslation: Rebel leader Zhu Yuanzhang led troops to defeat the Yuan army, ending the Yuan Dynasty.
